The '''High-Altitude Entry Transport-221''' ('''HAET-221'''), was a class of [[dropship]] that was used by the [[Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars]] and subsequently by the [[Galactic Empire]]. The HAET-221 was often deployed from [[cruiser]]s in orbit and descend towards the surface at a fast velocity. When it arrived over an area, it deployed its five passengers and then circled the area.<ref name="Forged in Battle" /> Several were used in the [[Occupation of Utapau|aftermath]] of the [[Battle of Utapau]] to support the Republic [[7th Sky Corps]].<ref name="Episode III">{{Film|III}}</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] utilized HAET-221s that it had discovered.<ref name="Forged in Battle" />
